title: [Main]-Issue in TDS calculation during payment application against invoices
summary: Fixed TDS calculation during payment application against invoices by scaling the applied amount to match the payment's TDS base, ensuring correct tax base computation when GST and payment amounts differ.
key_points: Applied amount on TDS advance payments is now scaled to the payment's TDS base instead of using the gross, GST-inclusive Amount to Apply
Formula: Amount to Apply × (Payment TDS Base ÷ Payment Amount), both taken from the payment's own TDS Entry
Scaling only applies when the payment's TDS base differs from its amount
Consumed original invoice amount is now scoped to the applied payment, which fixes wrong results on a second payment/invoice pair
Use case version bumped to 36 (JSON and registry) so it gets reimported
quote: Applied amount ko payment ke TDS base terms me scale kiya, sirf apply hone wale payment se scoped
